requested: Review the completed selective fada-fix-push migration on the ICE-Cal calibration branch
forbidden: commit push branch creation or remote mutation

review.scope: Independent final review of the migrated diff, contracts, tests, and evidence.

source_edits.scope: Selective local migration into the existing target branch without commit or push.

report_write.scope: Persist local plans, contracts, module evidence, and review receipts.

repository_discipline.rationale: The migration preserves contract-first ownership, backend isolation, cold-path metadata access, and evidence-only claims.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Phase, trainer, checkpoint, source collection, target adaptation, collector transaction, and async runtime have separate owner modules; scripts compose them.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The stable Planner-IDM and playback interfaces remain available to all target calibration consumers.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Backend lifecycle methods are declared on SimBackend and target-specific rules do not leak into scripts or fada_context.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Schema 4 owns v010 stage transfer while schemas 1 through 3 remain inference-readable and mixed-version training fails closed.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The selective transplant excludes donor machine artifacts and target calibration replacement; obsolete v005 tests are retired with their replaced API.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Current offline module, impacted, static, and repository test results are recorded without runtime or policy-quality promotion.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Observation projection, state/action history, IDM role labels, command scenarios, and checkpoint identities have direct regression coverage.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: IDM pretraining and Planner training have mutually exclusive optimizer ownership; Planner phase seals IDM tensors, gradients, mode, and digest.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema-4 save, stage transfer, deployable playback, legacy inference, and adaptation rejection paths have current persistence pseudo-samples.

residual_risks.description: No fresh formal runtime or simulator audit has run for the migrated target.
residual_risks.disposition: Require formal-runtime-audit and separate authorization before live execution.

residual_risks.description: Offline evidence does not establish convergence, walking stability, or policy quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Evaluate these only after separately authorized training.

residual_risks.description: Four whole-repository tests fail because three formal DAgger spec files are absent from both target base and donor.
residual_risks.disposition: Treat as a pre-existing repository evidence gap outside this migration.

residual_risks.description: scripts/train_distill.py retains 33 pre-existing Pyright errors on unchanged lines.
residual_risks.disposition: Address in a separate type-cleanup transaction; migrated libraries and new scripts report zero errors.
